who.versions_affected: ASA and FTD releases prior to the April 2024 fixed builds

what.summary: An actor chained a denial of service flaw with a persistent code execution flaw in the WebVPN service to load memory-resident and disk-resident implants on perimeter appliances.

how.logic: A perimeter appliance reboots or produces a crash dump with no matching change record, then a configuration write or client profile change lands within a short window. Either event alone is routine; the pairing is not.
how.caveat: Planned maintenance produces the same pair. Correlate against the change window before treating it as an issue.

how.logic: The vendor integrity check reports a mismatch, or a file appears in the appliance filesystem that is not part of a shipped image.

public.notes: Written from general knowledge. Re-read the source and set status to verified before relying on the CVE pairing or the dates.

what.summary: A process historian bridging the plant network and the business network was used to reach control-system data from an enterprise foothold.

how.logic: The historian authenticates an interactive session sourced from the enterprise network rather than from its usual engineering workstations, then opens an outbound connection to a destination it has no history of contacting.
how.caveat: Vendor remote support uses the same path. Maintain an allow list of support source addresses.

where.title: Example Intel commentary on historian network bridging
